mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_event (book_id, name, description, sequence_order, confidence, review_status, evidence_paragraph_id, evidence_image_id) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{sequenceOrder}, #{confidence}, #{reviewStatus}, #{evidenceParagraphId}, #{evidenceImageId})

INSERT INTO knowledge_entity (book_id, entity_type, reference_type, reference_id, name, description, review_status) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{entityType}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{reviewStatus})

INSERT INTO event_participant (event_id, knowledge_entity_id, participant_role, evidence_paragraph_id, evidence_image_id) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{knowledgeEntityId}, #{participantRole}, #{evidenceParagraphId}, #{evidenceImageId})

INSERT INTO knowledge_relation (book_id, source_entity_id, relation_type, target_entity_id, description, confidence, review_status, evidence_paragraph_id, evidence_image_id) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{sourceEntityId}, #{relationType}, #{targetEntityId}, #{description}, #{confidence}, #{reviewStatus}, #{evidenceParagraphId}, #{evidenceImageId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id, name, description, sequence_order, confidence, review_status, evidence_paragraph_id, evidence_image_id FROM story_event WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY sequence_order, id
SELECT id, book_id, entity_type, reference_type, reference_id, name, description, review_status FROM knowledge_entity WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY entity_type, name

SELECT ep.id, ep.event_id, ep.knowledge_entity_id, ep.participant_role, ep.evidence_paragraph_id, ep.evidence_image_id FROM event_participant ep JOIN story_event se ON se.id = ep.event_id WHERE se.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY ep.event_id, ep.id

SELECT id, book_id, source_entity_id, relation_type, target_entity_id, description, confidence, review_status, evidence_paragraph_id, evidence_image_id FROM knowledge_relation WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = 'KG_BUILT', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{bookId}
